paragraphs: This is This Week in Congress, from Power to the People, for the week ending Saturday, October 24th, 2026.
This briefing is read by a computer voice. Every fact in it comes from public records at Congress.gov, the House Clerk and Senate.gov.
The Senate held no recorded votes this week.
The House held no recorded votes this week.

Ten bills became law: the Critical Infrastructure Manufacturing Feasibility Act, the Clergy Act, the Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe Project Lands Restoration Act, the Romance Scam Prevention Act, the Southcentral Foundation Land Transfer Act of 2025, the Enhancing Detection of Human Trafficking Act, the Vicksburg National Military Park Boundary Modification Act, the Chiricahua National Park Act, the License to Drill Act, and House bill 837.
Coming up, the Senate next meets Monday, October 26th, 2026. The plan: convene for a pro forma session at 5:30 p.m. The House has not posted a floor schedule.
That's this week in Congress. You can read every bill and every vote in the app. Thanks for listening.
voice: Norman (Piper text to speech, public domain)
